suggestions.pitch: Jordan Travis and Chig Okonkwo are bench pieces, and Tyreek Hill plus Cooper Kupp would both start for me, from an 0-3 team that should sell.
Ricky Pearsall has stopped scoring, and Travis Kelce at TE plus Justin Fields as QB depth raise my lineup for the stretch run.
Najee Harris and Isiah Pacheco for Geno Smith adds a QB who starts every week at a likely acceptable price.
